tweets.text: In 2010, a bug in Bitcoin block 74,638 created 184 billion BTC out of thin air. Satoshi had to roll out a soft fork within five hours to erase the transaction and fix the chain.

tweets.author: lowestodd.bsky.social
tweets.text: In August 2010, an integer overflow bug in Bitcoin created 184 billion BTC out of thin air in block 74,638. Satoshi noticed, fixed the code, and rolled back the chain within five hours. It remains the only emergency rollback in Bitcoin history.
